question: At the Taiwan Athletics Open, which took place in Taipei on 7 and 8 June 2025, how many total medals did India win?
solution:
The correct answer is __**16**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian athletics contingent** concluded their campaign at the **Taiwan Athletics Open**, held in **Taipei** on **7 and 8 June 2025**, with a total of **16 medals**.
 
• Out of the total **16 medals**, the Indian athletes secured **7 Gold**, **6 Silver**, and **3 Bronze** medals across various track and field events.
 
• The event took place at the **Taipei Municipal Stadium** in **Chinese Taipei**, serving as a significant international exposure for the athletes to improve their **world rankings**.
 
• On the **opening day** of the competition, India made a strong start by clinching **seven medals**, which set the tone for the final tally of **16**.
 
• Leading the charge were prominent athletes such as **D.P. Manu** in javelin and **Jyothi Yarraji** in hurdles, both of whom secured top podium finishes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Individual Gold Medalists**:
 
 
• **D.P. Manu** won the **Gold medal** in the **men's javelin throw** with a best effort of **81.58 meters**, reaffirming his position as one of India's top throwers.
 
• **Jyothi Yarraji** clinched the **Gold** in the **women's 100m hurdles**, clocking a time of **13.23 seconds** to dominate the field.
 
• **Kiran Pahal** secured the **Gold** in the **women's 400m** race with a timing of **52.51 seconds**.
 
• In the **shot put** events, **Tajinderpal Singh Toor** (men) and **Abha Khatua** (women) both brought home **Gold medals** with throws of **19.17 meters** and **17.56 meters** respectively.
 
 
 
• **Silver and Bronze Contributions**:
 
 
• **Nithya Ramraj** finished just behind Jyothi Yarraji to take the **Silver medal** in the **women's 100m hurdles**, making it a 1-2 finish for India.
 
• The **men's 4x400m relay team** and other specialized track athletes contributed significantly to the **6 Silver** and **3 Bronze** count, ensuring India finished high in the overall standings.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of the Event**: The **Taiwan Athletics Open** is a **World Athletics Continental Tour Bronze** level meet, which is crucial for athletes aiming to accumulate **ranking points** for major championships like the **World Athletics Championships** and the **Olympics**.
 
• **Performance Consistency**: The **16-medal haul** reflects the growing depth in **Indian athletics**, particularly in technical events like **javelin throw** and **shot put**, as well as sprint hurdles.
 
• **Key Participants**: Other notable participants included **Nayana James**, who won **Gold** in the **women's long jump**, contributing to the dominant **7 Gold** medal tally.
 
• **Administrative Body**: The participation was facilitated by the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)** to ensure that elite athletes maintain competitive rhythm during the international season.
